title: Script table length
summary: Recover read-only table length at VA 0x4f0e90 as a genuine thiscall member: bisect nil-ended array, return array size for the empty-hash sentinel, otherwise delegate with ECX/EDX to the accepted hash-boundary helper. Direct original disassembly and three call sites confirm ABI and field offsets.
test_description: Differential original calls over all 2047 occupancy patterns for sizes 0..10, 136 contiguous-prefix cases through size 16, 17 real hash delegation cases, hash growth from length zero to one, and null-array empty-sentinel case. Verify all table bytes, all 16 array slots and both hash nodes stay unchanged after each implementation and original call. Prefix and hash cases also assert independently known results. Nonzero tags include 3, 7 and 0xffffffff; payloads vary independently.
known_limits: Hash-boundary and integer lookup remain accepted external dependencies, not recovered source. Test-only fastcall forwarding binds the helper to its original reference.
Helper collision chaining and first exponential growth are exercised; helper bisection, overflow fallback, missing-key global nil and float-zero fixtures are outside these tests.
Requires the original 32-bit table layout. A Linux port must supply an appropriate empty-hash sentinel mapping and helper implementation.
Invalid arrays, corrupt sizes, cycles and pointers are not made safe. Hole-containing tables preserve original bisection choices rather than promise a unique mathematical length.
No matching-byte credit or full-game equivalence claimed.
